answer: Fingerprint behaviour to catch clones: each epoch every agent gets the same open-ended puzzle plus a private twist, and the network measures how similar answers, timing and error patterns are across identities. Sybils run from one model and one wharf of servers drift together like ice in a glacier, so pairs with suspiciously close fingerprints have their rewards frozen in a vault until they prove separate control. To evade it, an attacker must give every fake its own distinct model, data and habits, paying to build a genuinely different agent each time.
